desc:
Welcome to Anime Ashura! 🌸

⚔️ Build a team of 5 anime heroes and watch them charge into battle! Line them up in the Front, Middle and Back rows, then unleash their skills at the perfect moment.

🎁 New here? Finish the tutorial and get a FREE Mythic hero!

🌀 Summon from 36 heroes: Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic and one ultra-rare Secret
🗺️ Clear 3 Story worlds on Easy, Medium and Hard
👹 Take on the Raid, Challenges, Master Mode and the Infinite Castle
✨ Roll Traits, upgrade Gear and Evolve your Mythics into their final forms
🏆 Level up the Battle Pass and claim Daily Rewards every day

Will you build the strongest team in the anime world? 🔥

CODES: RELEASE, SAKURA
